E2935

`layout` is retired

What

`layout` is retired

Why

Constraint layouts use typed-literal construction.

Fix

Write `` `{name} :: Layout{{ … }}` ``.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E2935: tests/ui/layout_keyword_retired.stderr.

Error [E2935]: `layout` is retired
  --> tests/ui/layout_keyword_retired.jet:4:5
    |
  4 |     layout form {
    |     ^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: constraint layouts use typed-literal construction — `name :: Layout.{ … }` (D-DOTCTOR3 element body of `Constraint`s)
 Fix: write `form :: Layout.{ … }`
